# EML Attachment Remover 2.0.1

Version 2.0.1 fixes readable text-only rendering for messages that carry equivalent
plain and HTML alternatives. It keeps the original message unchanged, retains only
canonical plain text, and removes embedded body resources and ordinary attachments as
before.

## Fixed

- The application now uses local HTML paragraph, list, table, and quotation structure
  when—and only when—the HTML alternative has identical non-whitespace text to the
  selected safe plain body.
- This restores readable question-and-answer and quoted-message structure in mail
  clients without retaining HTML, loading remote content, or using image heuristics.

## Verify the download

CPython 3.14.x is required.

- `remove-eml-attachments.pyz` — dependency-free CPython 3.14 zipapp
- `eml_attachment_remover-2.0.1-cp314-none-any.whl` — CPython 3.14 wheel
- `eml_attachment_remover-2.0.1.tar.gz` — source distribution
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for all three executable/package assets

Download all four files into one directory, then run:

```sh
shasum -a 256 --check SHA256SUMS
for asset in \
  remove-eml-attachments.pyz \
  eml_attachment_remover-2.0.1-cp314-none-any.whl \
  eml_attachment_remover-2.0.1.tar.gz \
  SHA256SUMS
do
  gh release verify-asset v2.0.1 "$asset" \
    --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover
  gh attestation verify "$asset" \
    --repo resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover \
    --signer-workflow resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/.github/workflows/release.yml \
    --source-ref refs/tags/v2.0.1
done
python3.14 remove-eml-attachments.pyz --version
```

See the [README](https://github.com/resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/blob/v2.0.1/README.md)
for usage and the [changelog](https://github.com/resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/blob/v2.0.1/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete history. **Full changelog:**
https://github.com/resoltico/EMLAttachmentRemover/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1
